name: Disco Lift
description: Wide jet sweep with resonant positive-feedback flanging, a bright shelf and a small room; no high-pass or echo.

name: Jackin Pressure
description: Hard eighth-note chopping into crunchy drive. A rhythmic dry-bus transformation without filter or delay.

name: Hands Up Wash
description: A resonant high-pass sweep dissolves into an almost fully wet, bright large room; no echo.

name: Late Night Echo
description: An exposed dotted-eighth ping-pong tape throw, with dark feedback and no filter sweep or room.

name: Snare Ladder
description: Captured forward slices accelerate from a quarter note to a 1/128-note buzz, with increasing grit.

name: Digital Meltdown
description: Full-band four-bit, 1.4 kHz sample-and-hold destruction. No high-pass, delay or reverb hides the aliasing.

name: Warehouse Siren
description: A rising octave siren passes through resonant flanging and quarter-note repeats.

name: White Heat
description: A bright white-noise ascent spreads into a huge low-damping room; no high-pass or discrete echo.

name: Vinyl Tunnel
description: A deep stereo four-stage phaser with feedback, followed by a slowly narrowing band-pass corridor.

name: Reverse Tease
description: A held reversed eighth-note fragment takes over early, then blooms into a short dark room.

name: Pump It Up
description: Sixteenth-note hard gating alternates with fast stereo movement. No tonal sweep or time effect.

name: The Big Finish
description: Six stages: low-pass closure, five-bit crush, ping-pong delay, huge reverb, accelerating stutter and jet flanging.

name: Velvet Balcony
description: A smooth, deep low-pass descent to 220 Hz. Pure filter movement without wash, echo or modulation.

name: Vocal Comet
description: A full half-note stereo throw rings into a bright large room; the dry low end is not swept away.

name: Rooftop Shimmer
description: Deep moving chorus, air shelf and restrained ambience. No high-pass, stutter or repeating echo.

name: Bassline Orbit
description: Negative-polarity comb sweeps orbit the stereo field while a gentle low-pass darkens the top.

name: Percussion Staircase
description: A whole quarter-note loop locks in early and stays at the same length while triplet gating intensifies.

name: Neon Exit
description: Eight-bit telephone-rate crunch closes through a resonant low-pass into saturated short mono tape repeats.

name: Pink Champagne
description: The input recedes beneath a descending low pink-noise swell, slow stereo movement and a small dark room.

name: Dub Elevator
description: Bass shelf removal feeds long dotted-quarter tape feedback, then a slow resonant phase sweep with a compensated wet return.

name: Midnight Pendulum
description: Full-width triplet panning with triplet-quarter clean repeats and fast phase movement.

name: Starlight Call
description: A descending C5 siren with fast vibrato floats above long dark reverb; no discrete echo.

name: Filter Confetti
description: Pure resonant 24 dB/octave high-pass rise to 6 kHz. No echo, modulation, bit reduction or reverb.

name: Last Train Home
description: A deep low-pass descent smears into an almost fully wet dark hall, with a late held reverse sixteenth-note loop.
